rv.q: Although all the material is part of Lynette's personal and searing life story, she didn't quite figure out how to connect the dots between those two essential elements of the musical.
The show is a defiant and raw challenge to the audience.
Lynette’s story is important, relatable, and empowering.
There are times that we need to truly crane our necks to see the action which for some can make it hard to follow.

cn.t: Nikki Lynette's deeply personal autobiographical musical earns praise for its raw vulnerability and unflinching exploration of depression and survival, with critics commending her courageous storytelling and celebration of life.
